bio.text: Shawn Johnson is the Libertarian candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026.
In the WyoFile election guide response, Johnson says Casper is the birthplace and Thermopolis the current home.

The response says Johnson served 21 years in the Army National Guard as a combat medic, including a deployment to Iraq in 2003-2004, and 13 years as a jail deputy with the Natrona County Sheriff's Office.
It also says Johnson served on the Casper City Council from 2014 to 2022, earned a law degree from Mitchell Hamline School of Law, and is now an attorney.
